opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at historic buildings and landscapes of outstanding significance.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority in the UK working with disability; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment helping people with disabilities to live more independently, particularly training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority in the UK working in mental health; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority in the UK providing care and services for older people; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK operating libraries/archives caring for nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK operating museums/galleries holding nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK focused on professional performance, with performing arts constituting the vast majority of activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities of performing arts organisations, generally for building or refurbishing facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university in the UK displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK supporting special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs; if applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment supporting pupils at secondary level in special schools and colleges to develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards projects helping high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching of specialist subjects (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts) at GCSE and A-Level. One-stage application process. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
